items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Was he more like Bowlin? Just like Bowlin and all that stuff. But the thing about Freddie Kepard, he was more of a musician than Bowlin.

ctx.x: How did Freddie Kepard play? What style was he?

I'm telling you, see, just like a- Was he more like Bowlin? Just like Bowlin and all that stuff. Just like Bowlin and all that stuff. But the thing about Freddie Kepard, he was more of a musician than Bowlin. You understand? He could play more late numbers. Them days you'd take five or six numbers and play them all night. But Freddie and them, they were musicians. You understand? They had music classes there. Musicians.
